programme.desc: This actioner revolves around the conflicts of kung fu masters. Complications further ensue when one of them falls for a princess.

programme.title: The Savage Five
programme.desc: At first, a gang just wants the village locksmith to open a stolen safe, but it soon escalates into wholesale torment when they are met with resistance.

programme.title: New Tales of the Flying Fox
programme.desc: A Shaw kung fu classic from 1984, this film depicts the trials of a young hero who sets out to avenge his parents' death.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: After a compulsive gambler's wife leaves him, he gets offered a beautiful ghost as his new wife.

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Director Lu Chun-ku leads Liu Yung, Liang Yun-hsin and 'Thundering Mantis,' Liang Chia-jen on a madcap quest filled with double crosses and triple plots.

programme.title: Dawn Will Come
programme.desc: In true Huangmei opera style, lovely Li Hsiang-chun stars as a used and abused beauty in director Kao Li's restrained, as well as sadistic tearjerker.

programme.title: Two Champions of Shaolin
programme.desc: Two rebel Shaolin warriors embark on a deadly secret mission aimed at bringing down the Ching Dynasty. Starring Lo Meng, Chin Siu Ho.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Three single females and the men they fall for think things are simple and blissful until the lasses' parents enter into the picture.

programme.title: The Magnificent Trio
programme.desc: A trio of heroes go up against a power-hungry Ming Dynasty official and also cross paths with three beauties.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: Hsu Hsia, a great kung fu actor himself, both directs and leads a team of four martial arts choreographers in his hilarious tale of 'kung fu pickpockets.'.

programme.title: Angel With the Iron Fists
programme.desc: After her father is killed by gangsters, a young woman seeks revenge plus bids to ensure that justice is served. Starring Lily Ho.

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: The court intrigues, politicking, bickering and backstabbing continues in this sequel to The Empress Dowager. Starring Lisa Lu.

programme.title: The Hidden Power of Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: When defeated villain, Sung Ching-shu, restarts his reign of terror after mastering the yin and yang combination, only two swordsmen can stop him.

programme.title: Torrent of Desire
programme.desc: Flames of lust burn strongly in this high-octane melodrama that stars Jenny Hu, Yang Fan and Qiao Zhuang.

programme.title: Lion VS Lion
programme.desc: A man comes across a secret list of anti-Ching rebel names and quickly becomes a target for Ching loyalists.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: After Ah Niu moves to Hong Kong, a kind-hearted fellow from rural China is taken advantage by cunning characters including his uncle.

programme.title: Opium and the Kung-Fu Master
programme.desc: Legendary kung fu choreographer Tang Chia's last work is one of the greatest ever, and one of Shaw Brothers' finest movies ever produced.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: In this masterpiece from Li Han Hsiang, sparks fly when minister Cheng Pu decides to marry off his youngest daughter before his eldest one.

programme.title: King Cat
programme.desc: Witness the exploits of Chan Chao- an advocate of justice who thwarts the plans of Minister Peng to assassinate the revered Judge Pao Cheng over and over again.

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: When deadbeats Ming and Liang stumble upon records of scandals involving government officials, what follows is a humorous misadventure of epic proportions.

programme.title: Pursuit
programme.desc: Written and directed by Cheng Kang, this classic film starring Yueh Wah depicts how the Sung Dynasty army's chief instructor is framed by a corrupt minister.

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll by
programme.desc: A doctor falls for a schizophrenic old classmate he's treating who refuses to accept that her lover is dead.

programme.title: Ode to Gallantry
programme.desc: Directed by Chang cheh, this kung fu film is one of the final efforts in the 'Venoms'' genre. It features a main character who is mistaken for a clan leader.

programme.title: Call of the Sea
programme.desc: In this action-packed thriller, director Lo Wei plays a fishing village bully, whose son lusts after a local beauty.

programme.title: Legendary Weapons of China
programme.desc: When a top boxer (Lau Kar Leung) refuses to obey an imperial eunuch, other martial arts experts are sent to hunt him down and kill him.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Fans of 'The Little Mermaid' are in for a delightful surprise when they see this spectacular Chinese operatic adaptation, where a carp turns into a fairy.

programme.title: Swordsman and Enchantress
programme.desc: A woman sets up a troubled love triangle involving 2 swordsmen (Ti Lung and Lau Wing) and an enchanting lady (Ching Li).

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: A beauty is accused of slaying her boyfriends. After fleeing to Lantau Island, she seduces another man there.

programme.title: Return of the One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: The retired one-armed swordsman made his reappearance to fight against the brutal robbers and protect the peace of the martial art world.

programme.title: Legend of the Fox
programme.desc: This exciting tale of revenge features cameos from the director's three most popular 'Venoms,' Kuo Chue, Chiang Sheng and Lu Feng.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Wong Yue and Gordon Liu star in this entertaining 'hopping vampire' action comedy.

programme.title: Sons of Good Earth
programme.desc: This multiple award-winning film is King Hu's first solo production, a tale of the Sino-Japanese War that ends in artistic and emotional triumph.

programme.title: The Grand Substitution
programme.desc: Winner of Best Picture in the 12th Asian Film Festival, this Huangmei Opera epic stars Li Li Hua and Ivy Ling Po in a romance that stretches across the decades.

programme.title: The Wandering Swordsman
programme.desc: This entertaining 'Robin Hood' epic features a hero who steals from the thieves and gives to the poor which sets the thieves on the warpath.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: This Inoue Umetsugu musical depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching Ping and Pai Hung.

programme.title: Brothers Five
programme.desc: Superstar Cheng Pei-pei stars as Yen Lai, the one woman who can reunite the Kao brothers in a bid to save the Teng Lung Manor and avenge their father's death.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: After a kung-fu master (Lau Kar Leung) is crippled by a ruthless villain, he teaches a boy monkey kung-fu to avenge his shame.

programme.title: Perils of the Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: This well-named cliffhanger is fraught with adventure involving a mystery swordsman, a sensual swordswoman, an imperial assassin, a Ghost Mansion and more!

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee
programme.desc: The film's curious title refers to two props that signal a happy beginning to what develops into a tragic love story, linking a scholar and a local beauty.

programme.title: House of Traps
programme.desc: The 'Venoms' bid a fond farewell to their internationally beloved film series with this saga about a building that bristles with booby-trapped blades.

programme.title: The Kid With a Tattoo
programme.desc: Starring kung-fu comedienne Wang Yu on a mission of justice, this film is kicked into high gear by Yuen Hua, Yuan Pin and the villainous Wang Lung-wei.

programme.title: The Fastest Sword
programme.desc: From writer director Pan Lei comes this Chinese variation of Henry King's famous 1950's film about a persecuted swordsman.

programme.title: Little Dragon Maiden
programme.desc: The old and the new were mixed together to create a far-out period action love story.

programme.title: The Thunderbolt Fist
programme.desc: To save his son from being killed, the head of the Ping Pai Boxing Institute sends his son to be hidden by a master fighter. Will the boy prove a hero?

programme.title: The Deadly Duo
programme.desc: The 'iron triangle' comprising director Chang Cheh and stars David Chiang and Ti Lung produces this explosive kung fu epic.

programme.title: Inside the Forbidden City
programme.desc: This film marks the Shaw Brothers' quintessential 'Huangmei Opera' costume drama, with a superb performance from Ivy Ling Po and Chin Feng.

programme.title: The Dragon Creek
programme.desc: In one of her first roles, 'Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon' villain Cheng Pei Pei plays a kung-fu Nancy Drew who must face a secret serial killer.

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber
programme.desc: This epic classic charts a romance between two teenage cousins, who pursue their relationship despite objections from their respective families.

programme.title: Usurpers of Emperor's Power
programme.desc: When Prince Li of the Sung Dynasty is exiled with his lovely wife and faithful warrior, Li Lan, he later commits suicide. Now, it is up to Li Lan to avenge him.

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Sparks fly when a female doctor criticizes a fashion designer's creations, but love follows regardless.

programme.title: The Emperor and His Brother
programme.desc: This epic depicts how Chen Chia Lo and his men set out to persuade the Qing Emperor Chien Lung to acknowledge his Han bloodline and join the anti-Qing movement.

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: A young rebel goes into legend after being reincarnated to save his people from their tyrannical emperor.

programme.title: The Proud Twins
programme.desc: This tale of hidden treasure features the legendary Alexander Fu Sheng as a young wushu warrior, in a film considered director Chu Yuan's best ever.

programme.title: The Lark
programme.desc: 60s pop star Carrie Ku Mei plays pop star 'Little Lark' in her greatest role, in this romance that features some of the most popular Mandarin songs of all time.

programme.title: The Golden Knight
programme.desc: Veteran Yueh Feng made this 'Martial Arts World' saga of a masked master of the 'Black Sand Hand Technique,' starring Lily Ho in a dual role.

programme.title: Illicit Desire
programme.desc: Director Li Han Hsiang adapts three erotic tales from Chinese classical literature for the silver screen. Starring Tien Lie, Hu Chin and Chen Ping.

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: This gender-bending tale depicts the romance between a wealthy girl and a man disguised as a flunkey in order to be employed at her house.

programme.title: Love With the Perfect Stranger
programme.desc: Pauline Wong plays a pregnant student who marries a sympathetic, yet equally heartbroken, passer-by in Jamie Luk's directing debut.

programme.title: The Jade Raksha
programme.desc: Cheng Pei-pei turns human combine harvester as she hacks a path through life, avenging the death of her family under the moniker 'The Jade Raksha'.

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again
programme.desc: In this sequel, the Mad Monk is joined by immortal scholar-turned-genie, Lu Tung Pin, as they both wreak havoc in an attempt to outdo each other!

programme.title: Young Vagabond
programme.desc: A wine shop owner's son, who finds a brilliant martial arts coach in his private tutor, foils a plan by a thief but what happens when he returns for revenge?

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: Starring Kara Hui, Yuen Tak and Meng Yuen Man, this film depicts a series of battles as everyone fights over the 'Yuan Yang Swords', which hold the secrets to Kung Fu.

programme.title: Swift Sword

programme.title: The Kingdom and the Beauty
programme.desc: Catch superstar, Linda Lin Dai, in one of her most acclaimed roles in this story of forbidden love between a country maiden and the emperor.

programme.title: The Golden Seal
programme.desc: Award-winning actor Ku Feng plays the cunning pirate Lei Chen-tien, flanked by Wan Ping who disguises herself as a boy to beat him to the treasure.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: An insane swordsman takes to making Chinese lamps from the skin of his enemies' sisters, mistresses and wives!

programme.title: The Young Avenger
programme.desc: In veteran writer/ director Yueh Feng's most memorable martial arts movies, the luminous and lethal Shih Szu plays the title swordswoman.

programme.title: River of Tears
programme.desc: This tragic tale depicts the life of Fang Pi Yu, a singer whose husband dies in his attempt to free her from her past, and whose father-in-law throws her out.

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre 2
programme.desc: In Part 2 of this adventure, only the title weapons' union can save the 6 remaining sects which vie for mastery of the martial world.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: Directed by Lee Han-hsiang and starring Michael Hui, this blockbuster confirms Hui's versatile talents as the king of comedy.

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: As a young clan member rises to helm the Dragon gang after his foster father's death, an incriminating letter changes everything. Can he fight the tide?

programme.title: Heroes of the East
programme.desc: Trouble ensues after Ah To (Gordon Liu) marries a Japanese martial artist (Yuka Mizuno) and has a need to prove his martial prowess.

programme.title: The 82 Tenants

programme.desc: King Hu's groundbreaking film set the foundation for all his action films that followed, most notably Crouching Tiger Hidden Dragon.

programme.title: The Treasure Hunters

programme.title: The Purple Shell
programme.desc: Adapted from Chiung Yao's novel, this romance depicts how a wealthy man and a sweet girl discover that they are soulmates too late in life.

programme.title: Shaolin Mantis
programme.desc: Action king, David Chiang plays Wei Feng, who is sent to investigate the suspicious Tien family. However, he never expects to fall for the beautiful Chi.
